intro: AI agents from startups like Dazzle, Duckbill, and Wajo still rely on human workers to complete calls and real-world tasks when their software encounters limitations. OpenAI is reducing its fundraising target to $20 billion with a $1.25 trillion valuation, down from earlier goals, amid broader market pressures. Sam Altman argued that consumer PCs should have less RAM to preserve resources for data centers, a position that drew public pushback.
